methods.label: Use the circle area formula
methods.explanation:
A circle's area is proportional to the square of its radius, so doubling the area gives
\[
\pi(r+n)^2=2\pi r^2.
\]
Here \(r>0\) and \(n>0\). Canceling \(\pi\) and taking positive square roots, since both radii are positive, gives
\[
r+n=\sqrt{2}r,
\qquad n=(\sqrt{2}-1)r.
\]
Because \(\sqrt{2}-1>0\), we may divide by it. Multiplying numerator and denominator by \(\sqrt{2}+1\) then gives
\[
r=\frac{n}{\sqrt{2}-1}
=\frac{n(\sqrt{2}+1)}{2-1}
=n(\sqrt{2}+1).
\]
Thus \(r=n(\sqrt{2}+1)\), choice A.
